values.note: Nights are booked on Campspot ('Nightly Reservation' on the park's site); long stays go through a separate 'Long Term Application'. Short-term cancellations: 15+ days a refund less $25, 8-14 days half less $25, 0-7 days none. Short-term guests may bring one vehicle.

values.note: $49 a night, $240 a week; monthly $595 Value, $745 Standard, $795 Premium. On Campspot the park adds 3% of the site charge as a 'Credit Card Fee' and 3% as a 'Reservation System Fee' (about $51.94 a night all in, before tax).

fees.source: https://www.broadrivercampground.com/map-and-rates ('Nightly Rate $49', 'Weekly Rate $240', Value Site $595, Standard Site $745, Premium Site $795) + Campspot pricing read 2026-10-13 (campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl), read 2026-10-21

summary: Operator site confirms $49 nightly, 20/30/50-amp full hookups on every site, laundry/bathhouse/Wi-Fi/store, Campspot nightly booking. Added 143 sites to 75 ft in three classes, booking URL and terms. Note kept. Flagged as a mostly long-stay, workforce park whose rules require an approved application, and for the 6% per-night Campspot fees that take the night just over US$50.
flags: Long-stay / workforce test: the park markets itself to workers at Plant V.C. Summer ('a very short drive to and from work'), headlines monthly rates ($595-795) with a 'Long Term Application', and its Park Rules say 'All persons staying in the RV Park must be registered via the online application process and must be approved by the Park Manager to stay overnight in the Park' (https://www.broadrivercampground.com/parkrules). Nights are sold on Campspot at $49, but the approval rule fails the 'no application or approval' test as written.

Price gate, borderline: base $49, but Campspot adds a 3% 'Credit Card Fee' and a 3% 'Reservation System Fee' on the site charge, so they scale with nights (~$51.94 a night before tax). No gateway within 40 km (Congaree NP 56 km), not a Good Sam Park, and the family has not stayed here.
